messages.subject: Occu example
parts:
Hi there

Id like to post the workings and results of the occupancy analysis I have done to get some feedback from more knowledgeable and experienced users is possible. Id really appreciate any comments. Thank you!

Background:

I have acoustic activity data recorded over 34 nights from a bat detector at one site. It recorded 4 species and I am doing the occupancy analysis separately for each species. I have four covariates: mean wind speed, mean temperature, mean barometric pressure and moon phase. First, id like to determine the detection probability. The following is what I did for the first species:

Occu <- read.csv("Occupancy3.csv")
y <- Occu[,2]    
y <- t(y)
covs <- rbind(Occu[,7:10]) 

library(unmarked)
umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=y, obsCov=covs)
summary(umf)

obsCovs(umf) <- scale(obsCovs(umf))
summary(umf)

fm1 <- occu(~1~1,umf)             #no covariates
summary(fm1)
fm2 <- occu(~Moon~1,umf)
summary(fm2)
fm3 <- occu(~MeanWS~1,umf)
summary(fm3)
fm4 <- occu(~MeanTE~1,umf)
summary(fm4)
fm5 <- occu(~MeanBP~1,umf)
summary(fm5)
fm6 <- occu(~Moon+MeanWS+MeanTE+MeanBP~1,umf)
summary(fm6)

models <- fitList('psi(.)p(.)' = fm1,
                  'psi(Moon)p(.)' = fm2,
                  'psi(Wind)p(.)' = fm3,
                  'psi(Temp)p(.)' = fm4,
                  'psi(Pressure)p(.)' = fm5,
                  'psi(Moon+Wind+Temp+Pressure)p(.)' = fm6)
ms <- modSel(models)
ms
